# Imgix

imgix is a real-time image processing and delivery service that enables developers to optimize, transform, and deliver images efficiently.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/imgix/.

## Actions

- **Adjust Image Brightness**: Adjust image brightness.
- **Adjust Image Contrast**: Adjust image contrast.
- **Adjust Image DPI**: Embed DPI (dots-per-inch) metadata for print output on an Imgix-rendered image.
- **Adjust Image Highlights**: Adjust highlight tonal mapping (−100 to 0).
- **Blend Color Over Image**: Blend a solid color over an image using CSS keyword or hex.
- **Blend Overlay**: Overlay an image, text, or color onto a base image using imgix blending parameters.
- **Draw Image Border**: Draw a border around an image.
- **Extract Image Color Palette**: Specify how many colors to return when extracting a color palette.
- **Force Aspect Ratio**: Force a target aspect ratio on an Imgix image.
- **Imgix Auto Optimization**: Apply automatic best-effort image optimizations.
- **Imgix Blend Align**: Align the overlay relative to the base image when blending.
- **Imgix Blend X Position**: Position the overlay horizontally on an Imgix-rendered image.
- **Imgix Mark Height**: Set watermark height on an Imgix URL in pixels or as a ratio of the watermark source.
- **Imgix Rotate**: Rotate an image on Imgix.
- **Imgix URL Expiration**: Append an expiration parameter to an Imgix URL so it returns 404 after a given time.
- **IMGIX_CH**: Opt in to Client Hints.
- **IMGIX_CROP**: Control cropping alignment and behavior using Imgix's 'crop' parameter.
- **IMGIX_CS**: Set or strip output color space/profile on an Imgix image.
- **IMGIX_DL**: Force asset download.
- **IMGIX_FIT**: Control how an image fits target dimensions after resizing.
- **IMGIX_FM**: Choose output file format for the rendered asset.
- **IMGIX_H**: Set output image height in pixels or as a ratio of the source height.
- **IMGIX_LIST_SOURCES**: List all Sources for an account.
- **IMGIX_MARK_PAD**: Set pixel padding between a watermark and the image edge or between tiled watermarks.
- **IMGIX_MASK**: Apply a mask to an image.
- **IMGIX_MAX_H**: Limit output image height.
- **IMGIX_MAX_W**: Set the maximum output width on an Imgix URL.
- **IMGIX_PALETTE**: Extract a color palette from an image in CSS or JSON form.
- **IMGIX_RECT**: Select a source-image rectangle region in Imgix before other resizing.
- **IMGIX_ROT_TYPE**: Control rotation behavior when rot is applied.
- **IMGIX_TXT_ALIGN**: Align a text overlay on an Imgix image.
- **IMGIX_TXT_SHAD**: Set text shadow strength for overlay text.
- **IMGIX_TXT_SIZE**: Set text font size in pixels.
- **Set CSS Palette Prefix**: Set class-name prefix for CSS palette output.
- **Set Device Pixel Ratio**: Set device pixel ratio for an Imgix image.
- **Set Output Quality**: Set output quality for lossy formats.
- **Set Text Color**: Set text overlay color on an Imgix image.
- **Set Text Font**: Choose font family/style for overlay text.
- **Set Text Outline Width**: Set outline width around overlay text.
- **Set Watermark Base URL**: Set the base URL prepended to the watermark image path.
- **Text Outline Color**: Set outline color for text.
- **Text Overlay**: Render a single-line UTF-8 text overlay on an image.
- **Watermark Fit Mode**: Set how a watermark fits its target dimensions.
- **Watermark Width**: Set watermark width.
